Third-party software and fonts of the reading site
==================================================

The site generator (tools/site_pages.py) copies this folder unchanged into site/assets/vendor/. Every file here is
an unmodified copy of a published release; each keeps its own licence, which travels with it.

PDF.js 6.2.108 (pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs, pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs)
    Copyright Mozilla Foundation and the PDF.js contributors. https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
    Apache License, Version 2.0: pdfjs/LICENSE. See also pdfjs/NOTICE.

KaTeX 0.18.4 (katex/katex.min.js, katex/katex.min.css, katex/fonts/)
    Copyright (c) 2013-2020 Khan Academy and other contributors. https://katex.org
    MIT License: katex/LICENSE.

New Computer Modern 7.0.1, the 10 pt Book, Book Italic and Bold faces (fonts/NewCM10-*.otf)
    (C) 2019-2020 Antonis Tsolomitis. GUST Font License (the LaTeX Project Public License 1.3c with the GUST
    request on derived works): fonts/GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt. Copied unchanged from TeX Live 2025; the package is
    at https://ctan.org/pkg/newcomputermodern. These are the faces in which the notes themselves are set.

JetBrains Mono 2.305, Regular and Bold (fonts/JetBrainsMono-*.otf)
    Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1: fonts/OFL-JetBrainsMono.txt.
    Copied unchanged from TeX Live 2025. The notes set Lean names in this face.
